raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Overview

Sleep mode level 2 discards the weights memory pool. On wake, only `model.named_buffers()` are restored in place, and parameters come back through the weight update. A device tensor that is built at load and kept as a plain attribute is therefore garbage after sleep level 2 + wake.

This PR fixes each such tensor at its own site. Most fixes are `register_buffer(name, t, persistent=False)` with the same tensor object, so addresses do not change. It adds no walker, no exemption table and no CI scan. Context: #54477, #50079.

## Fixed (one site each)
- NVFP4 emulation, linear and MoE: the layer holds the E2M1 lookup table as a buffer.
- NVFP4/FP8 MoE quant configs: `a1_gscale`/`a2_gscale` are layer buffers. Quark FP8 MoE now passes `layer=` so its scales get the same treatment.
- compressed-tensors NVFP4 MoE: `w13_input_scale`/`w2_input_scale` are buffers.
- DeepGEMM warmup reuses the layer's MoE quant config instead of rebuilding it (a rebuild would orphan the scales the kernel holds).
- MoE experts: a class declares `held_tensors`, and the loader registers them on the layer after post-load, in one place.
  - Declared: TRT-LLM FP8/MXFP4 and FlashInfer SwiGLU tensors, CuteDSL `per_token_global_scale`, B12x `_fc2_input_scale`, and Humming MoE locks.
- MXFP4 MoE: `_cache_permute_indices` is per call (the cached device indices fed the next weight shuffle after wake).
- Humming linear (MXFP4/6/8, NVFP4, mixed precision, FP8/INT8 scaled-mm, `HummingLinearMethod`): `locks` is a layer buffer.
- `Attention`: the impl's ALiBi slopes and fp32 sinks copy are layer buffers.
- `_k_scale_cpu`/`_v_scale_cpu` are created on CPU. They were built under the target-device context, so on main they landed on the GPU.
- DSv4.1 mega attention: the `permute_on_load` permutations are built on CPU (the weight-loader closures keep them).
- DSv4.1 fused mHC all-reduce: `_stage_state` is a model buffer.
- Model constants are buffers: GraniteSpeech `attention_dists`, Phi-4-MM `pe`, Bailing/MiniMax `tp_slope`, Gemma4 MTP `_suppress_idx`, Gemma4-DSpark `_v_norm_weights` (constant ones), OpenPangu-VL `inv_freq`.

## Known limitations / follow-ups
- MoE experts tensors not declared yet: CUTLASS FP8/W4A8 strides, TRT-LLM FP8 monolithic alphas, AITER top-k metadata, Triton MXFP4 swizzled weights.
- Kimi-K3 latent-MoE tail fusion still raises under sleep mode; unchanged here.
- Kimi-K3 `SpecializedDecode` state is built at load in the weights pool. It is off by default and rejects sleep mode.
- Held by non-module objects: DCP workspaces, EPLB maps, MiniMax Lamport workspace, Qwen4Exp `ngram_context_offsets`.
- LoRA slots: handled by #62358 (LoRA state restore on level-2 wake).
- Same pattern, left out: ROCm/XPU-only sites, INC `ark_bias`, CT wNa8o8 static scales, FlashAttn-MLA-sparse `cu_seqlens_q_buffer`, Qwen4Exp deepstack embeds.
- Weight-derived copies (DFlash, Gemma4-DSpark k-norm stack, Kimi-K3 DSpark context-KV norm weights/scales, beam DFlash2, LiLiCorr, DSv4/DSv4.1 `hc_attn_fn_broadcast`) stay plain attributes. Layerwise reload skips copying non-persistent buffers it did not load, so registered copies would come back stale. Fix that in reload first.
- Staleness after weight updates, not sleep (#57733 territory): MoE fused router/shared gate, GLM5-next `_wp_fp32`/`_merged_conv_weight`, CPU attention sinks cast, and non-persistent derived buffers on layerwise reload.
- Risk, layerwise reload: the CT NVFP4 `w13/w2_input_scale` and FP8/NVFP4 `a1/a2_gscale` buffers are not reloaded (non-persistent), so they keep pre-reload values; the rebuilt kernel uses fresh ones, and nothing else reads them after post-load today.
- Risk, IPC weight cache + DSv4.1 fused mHC: an IPC client replaces `_mhc_ar_stage_state` with the daemon's tensor, so it no longer aliases the kernel state and sleep restores the wrong memory.

## Validation
- `pre-commit` (incl. mypy) passes.
- Sleep A/B on GB200, main vs this PR, same node and config, real weights, CUDA graphs on. Per run: greedy baseline on 8 prompts (tokens + logprobs), cold GSM8K, then 3 x (`sleep(level=2)` -> wake -> restore -> regenerate), GSM8K after the last wake. Restore (i) = `reload_weights()` from the checkpoint; (ii) = in-place restore via `sleep_preserve_parameter_names=["*"]`. Backends were checked from the loaded model.

| Config (path exercised) | GSM8K cold main / PR | (i) reload main / PR | (ii) in-place main / PR |
|---|---|---|---|
| DSv4.1-Flash TP4 (mega-attn, MXFP8 linear, TRT-LLM MXFP4 experts, clamp_limit) | .896 / .868 | fail / fail (pre-existing, see below) | fail (GSM .016) / GSM .908, tokens 2/8* |
| GLM-5.3-Flash FP8 TP4 (TRT-LLM FP8 block MoE, clamp_limit) | .920 / .920 | fail (.016) / ok (.928) | fail (.008) / ok (.928) |
| Qwen3-30B-A3B NVFP4, TRT-LLM MoE (a1/a2_gscale) | .908 / .912 | fail (0) / ok, 8/8 x3 | fail (0) / ok, 8/8 x3 |
| Qwen3-30B-A3B NVFP4, emulation (E2M1 LUT) | .925 / .908 | ok / ok | ok / ok |
| Laguna-XS-2.1 CT NVFP4, TRT-LLM MoE (CT input scales) | .408 / .412 | fail / ok, 8/8 x3 | fail / ok, 8/8 x3 |
| Laguna-XS-2.1 CT NVFP4, emulation | .308 / .250 (n=120) | fail / ok | fail / ok |
| Qwen3-30B-A3B FP8 and NVFP4, Humming linear + MoE (locks) | .904 / .908, .888 / .896 | GSM unchanged both | GSM unchanged both** |
| bloom-560m ALiBi, Triton attention | .02 / .02 | fail / ok, 8/8 x3 | fail / ok, 8/8 x3 |
| bloom-560m ALiBi, FlashInfer | (tiny model) | ok / ok | ok / ok |
| gpt-oss-20b sinks, FlashInfer and Triton attention, TRT-LLM MXFP4 MoE | .324 / .324, .36 / .364 | fail / fail (pre-existing) | fail (0) / ok, 8/8 x3 |
| gpt-oss-20b, Triton MXFP4 MoE | .344 / .344 | fail / fail | fail / fail (Triton MXFP4 swizzled weights, listed above) |

  \* DSv4.1 is not bit-exact run to run (up to 4 of 8 prompts change between two generations without sleep). What still differs after wake: the weight-derived `hc_attn_fn_broadcast` (listed above) and runtime scratch (top-k and candidate-block buffers, Engram staged rows).
  \*\* Humming kernels are not deterministic run to run (1-3 of 8 prompts equal without sleep); main shows no failure because freshly mapped pages come back zeroed.
- All 3 sleep/wake cycles gave the same result as the first in every config.
- Pre-existing, also on main without any sleep: `reload_weights()` corrupts gpt-oss MXFP4 experts with the TRT-LLM and Marlin MoE backends (Triton is fine), and DSv4.1 output.
- Sleep mode with the custom all-reduce fails at startup on main too (`custom_all_reduce.cuh:164 invalid argument`), so TP4 runs disable it and the fused mHC all-reduce (`_mhc_ar_stage_state`) path could not be exercised under sleep.
- `test_initialization` for all touched architectures: 61 passed.
- Unit subset (NVFP4/MXFP4/MXFP6/MXFP8 kernel selection, NVFP4 emulation incl. the new test, TRT-LLM/CuteDSL/B12x/FlashInfer MoE, DeepGEMM warmup, Phi-4-MM, DSpark, DFlash, attention backends): 1269 passed. Failures are environment-only: 4 need gated `google/embeddinggemma-300m`; the 3 DSv4.1 mega-attn layout tests pass with DeepGEMM built at the tree's pin.
- Quantization model tests (Humming, Quark, FP8, ModelOpt, compressed-tensors): 327 passed; the same 9 fail on main.
- Sleep-mode tests (`test_sleep_mode`, `test_cumem`, `test_sleep_mode_backend`, `test_sleep_mode_tensor_ownership`, GDN sleep/wake): identical results on main; the failures are environment-only (forked CUDA in `test_cumem`) or pre-existing (GDN).
- `tests/model_executor/model_loader/`: 286 passed; every failure also fails on main (`test_ipc_rope_matching`, `test_kv_scale_reload`, IPC weight cache) or is environment-only (no `ray`, gated Llama).

**AI assistance.** Written with Claude Code. Kimi and an independent Claude reviewer audited the diff; Codex was unavailable because of its usage limit. Findings were checked against the source, then fixed or rejected with a reason. The submitter reviews every changed line.
